verdict.rationale: Checkout.com documents a Hosted Payment Page, described as "a pre-built, low-code payment page integration" that is customizable and offers "a fully branded checkout page in less than a day." Shareable Payment Links offer a second no-UI hosted option, so the core story is delivered without building your own payment UI. Missing for 10: documentation of the redirect/session-creation and return-URL flow, evidence that the hosted page itself is conversion-optimized (the conversion claims are made for Flow components), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
